scope: Single open-feedwater-heater Rankine extraction-pressure study; existing 30 tools retained.

features.grid: Linear, endpoints included, 2–41 distinct finite pressures; default 11. Only extraction pressure varies.
features.fixed: Condenser/boiler pressure, inlet steam condition, model, reference mass, two pump and two turbine efficiencies. Single-cycle pBleed is inactive.
metrics: specific net work per kg boiler steam
LP exit moisture; null outside saturation
features.maximum: Valid sampled points only; no continuous/global optimum claim.
features.invalid: Reason per point, null metrics, line gaps, excluded from maximum; all-invalid grid has no maximum.
features.selection: Chart keyboard/click or table row; valid point rebuilt in Worker and opened in existing editor.
features.storage: Canonical inputs, selection and chart metric in shared JSON; imported metrics ignored.
exports: CSV with fixed inputs, units, status, all points
SVG with canonical metadata and notes
UK/EN report with four plots/table and source reopening
features.background: Worker with termination/revision guards; 120s timeout, no partial completion; reports containing studies also render in Worker.

numerical.source: Independent Python iapws 1.5.5, generation only; NumPy/SciPy not in runtime.

checks.chromium_final: Passed extraction grid, ideal/actual both models, sampled maximum, gaps/null, selection/editor, CSV/SVG, project/reload/import, report/source, cancellation/edit/navigation/responsiveness, UK/EN and 320/390/768px.
checks.firefox_final: Same final scenario plus standalone sweep and report offline.
checks.calculator_async_final: Firefox passed responsiveness, cancellation/edit/model/import/reload, offline Worker and startup retry.
checks.previous_regeneration: Chromium full prior-sprint scenario passed before final input/status/report-cancellation refinements.
checks.cross_browser: Both browsers: all 30 sections, UK/EN, HTML/JSON, restore and 320/390/768px passed before final input/status/report-cancellation refinements.
checks.study_workflow: Chromium web/report/PDF journey passed; system Chromium file:// is blocked by administrator policy. Firefox complete journey and standalone offline passed before final refinements.
checks.release_core: All 14 checks passed on Node.js 22.23.3: 818 tests, water/transport/reactor software checks, deterministic build/package and ZIP integrity.
checks.print_pdf_final: Chromium: asynchronous Print/PDF invoked print once after completion; HTML and PDF with all four plots generated.
checks.unit_final: All 818 tests passed on Node.js 22.23.3, including independent grids and built Worker/report equivalence.

limitations: No continuous optimization, multiple parameters/heaters, reheat or pressure losses.
Moisture does not establish equipment suitability.
41-point timing is one local observation, not a performance guarantee.
Safari and physical touch devices not checked.
Existing reactor-cell physical screening remains failed and unchanged.
publication: Not requested in this sprint; full GitHub CI and Pages deployment not started.

physical_validation.scope: Independent cell screening; failure blocks claims of neutron-model physical validation, separately from software acceptance.
